github.description: GitHub integration for repository management, PRs, issues, code search

cargo-cicd-evidence.description: Read and parse XES evidence files and JSONL process events from cargo-cicd runs

cargo-cicd-workspace.description: Access Cargo.toml manifests and workspace members for inspection and validation

notes.wasm4pm: wasm4pm oracle (wpm) is invoked via Bash tool: wpm audit <file.xes> or wpm receipt doctor --format json --strict <receipt.json>. Not an MCP server — it's a local binary.
notes.evidence-dir: Evidence files are at target/cargo-cicd/evidence/. XES format for oracle, JSONL for machine parsing.
notes.scope: GitHub MCP is scoped to seanchatmangpt/cargo-cicd repository only.
